context: An elderly couple reminisces about cultural outings
purpose: Teach: テラス/童話/歌舞伎/戦国/神道/ステーキ/ボーカル/名所

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、テラスのある喫茶店、よく通ったな。
lines.en: When we were young, there was a cafe with a terrace we'd go to all the time.
lines.style: Gentle, distant gaze into memory. Warm opening. Unhurried pace, letting each image surface naturally. Voice carries the weight of decades but without melancholy—simple presence of having lived.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。子供たちに童話を読み聞かせたわね。
lines.en: Mm. We'd read fairy tales aloud to the children there.
lines.style: Soft affirmation, nodding into the memory. Slight brightness on the image of children. Unhurried, as though watching it happen again. Voice lined with the gentleness of someone who was there.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 結婚記念日に、歌舞伎座、二人で観劇したっけ。
lines.en: For our anniversary, we went to see a play at Kabuki-za together.
lines.style: Quiet recognition of something precious. Slight lift on the date marker. Measured, letting the significance settle. Trailing softly—a moment held, not rushed past.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 戦国大河、家族で見るの楽しみだったわね。
lines.en: The Sengoku period dramas—we looked forward to watching those with the family.
lines.style: Warm, almost gentle smile in the voice. Lift on the memory of family gathered. Steady, unhurried pace. The tone of someone savoring what was shared, not what was lost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 神道のお祭り、近所で毎年行ってた。
lines.en: The Shinto festival in the neighborhood—we went to that every year.
lines.style: Soft, matter-of-fact tenderness. No performance, just the stating of a good habit. Quiet emphasis on 「毎年」—the constancy of it. Voice lined with gratitude for routine.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 記念日にステーキを食べに行くの、続けたいわ。
lines.en: For our anniversaries, we'd go out for steak. Let's keep doing that.
lines.style: Gentle determination underneath. Not wistful—an intention stated quietly. Slight emphasis on 「続けたい」—a promise made softly to both of them. Present tense in the heart of it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 子の声楽発表、ボーカル教室の名物だったな。
lines.en: Our child's vocal recitals—those were legendary at the music school.
lines.style: Quiet pride, no inflation. Warm recognition of something that mattered. Slight brighten on the memory itself. Unhurried, letting the image settle. Voice carries the ease of someone who was genuinely proud.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 国内の名所、まだ巡りきれてないわよ。
lines.en: There are still so many places in Japan we haven't seen together.
lines.style: Gentle forward-looking warmth. Not regretful—an opening, a possibility stated softly. Slight lift at the end, like a quiet invitation. The voice of someone still imagining a future, not closing a door.
